name: L & L Electronics
old_description: We're a Printed Circuit Board Service Bureau, assisting companies like yours in the general electronics and aerospace industries.  L & L Electronics, originally located in Anaheim, California, has been providing high caliber design and full service assembly since 1985.  Now based in Albuquerque, New Mexico, we continue to offer our PCB expertise to a wider geographic area, from Silicon Valley and the West Coast, to the Rio Grande Research Corridor, to Texas and beyond.  David and Lisa Lidderdale and the quality-conscious L & L team have always made customer service the top priority.  When it comes to your business, that means distinct advantages for you.
about:
L & L Electronics was founded in 1985 by David and Lisa Lidderdale in Anaheim, California. The company later moved to Albuquerque, New Mexico, where it operates today as a printed circuit board service bureau assisting companies in the general electronics and aerospace industries.

The firm provides PCB design, assembly, and fabrication services, with fabrication outsourced to partners. It handles double-sided and multi-layer boards, standard and fine-line geometries, surface-mount and through-hole assembly, and supports both prototype and full production runs. Design services include fabrication and assembly drawings created in AutoCAD, and the company offers interface capabilities for various PCB requirements.

L & L serves customers from Silicon Valley and the West Coast to the Rio Grande Research Corridor and Texas, providing expertise across a wide geographic area. Its client base spans general electronics and aerospace sectors.

The founders emphasize that a quality-conscious team and customer service as the top priority distinguish the company, a principle maintained since its inception.
